verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.claude.com (HTTP 200). Claude Code's docs are also served as markdown (overview.md), and that page points to a dedicated index at code.claude.com/docs/llms.txt, so agents can be pointed at agent-oriented docs. Other docs pages, such as mcp.md and sandboxing.md, are likewise served as .md. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs, and the Claude Code-specific llms.txt was referenced but not probed directly.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
